podcast.body: A Bruce Springsteen cover that became one of Tom Morello's all-time favorite songs. Rage Against the Machine had been playing this song live for many years before it was officially included on their covers album, Renegades. It also appeared on a collection of videos in 1997. "Rage had been playing the Ghost of Tom Jode for years. It was included on a collection of videos in 1997, and it showed up on Renegades."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: Rage Against the Machine created a distinctively loud cover of this Bruce Springsteen folk song. It appeared as the first full song on their 1997 video concert album, was released as a single, and was included on their 2000 album "Renegades." A live recording also exists featuring Tom Morello performing alongside Bruce Springsteen and the E Street Band. "In 1997, Rage released a self-titled video concert album on VHS that included a very loud cover of the song."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
